newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Coceral sees possible 4.0 mln tonnes extra wheat exports.
newsitem.headline: Coceral sees possible 4.0 mln tonnes extra wheat exports.

text.p: The European Union could export a possible four million tonnes more wheat during the remainder of 1996/97 (July/June), Coceral, the EU grain trade lobby said on Thursday.
In addition, Coceral said the European Commission envisaged an extra 1.0 to 1.2 million tonnes of flour exports by the end of the season.
"It depends on the European Commission," a Coceral official said, adding that it had not issued a 1996/97 export forecast.
On Tuesday, Reuters erroneously said Coceral forecast EU exports of soft wheat and flour will total 16.4 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), up from 12.1 million tonnes in 1995/96.
Up until February 7, the EU exported seven million tonnes of wheat grain and 4.3 million tonnes of wheat eqvivalent in flour.
Coceral added that its 1996/97 grain crop estimate remained unchanged from December at 203.1 million tonnes.

On Tuesday, Reuters erroneously said that Coceral had raised its estimate to 204.3 million tonnes. The grain trade lobby said this figure was put forward by EU member states at a meeting of the EU cereals advisory committee last week.
